choreography.source: Shipped 279 is a CombatSpecialMove selected special. Deadly Throw has no ILDB move or script _Subject of its own; the shipped Spy throw scripts use Action_FreeAttackWeaponSMKnifeThrow.
choreography.runtime: AtRestSpecialMotion plays the targeted free-attack motion record (StealthShieldAbilities.PlayThrow with the action byte) when the cast lands at rest; interlocked casts keep their round presentation.
choreography.test: AtRestSpecialMotionTests pins the record bytes and action-table entry. Stock PR1200 native QA at 8bdc410a saw the targeted knife-throw swing (FreeAttackWeaponSMKnifeThrow 0x40) with no fight started. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1200#issuecomment-7169429641

choreography.source: Shipped 287 is a CombatSpecialMove instant sneak opener; the ILDB "Sneak Attacks" group names its move 19597 (Suplex).
choreography.runtime: SneakOpenerRound presents an at-rest landing as one Close Combat exchange naming 19597, with no fight, then restores each fighter's pose.
